Title: Public preview: Application Insights auto-instrumentation of .NET apps on Linux

Body.Content:
Application Insights is the Application Performance Management (APM) observability feature of Azure Monitor, natively integrated across various Azure Compute offerings. The service allows developers to detect, triage, and diagnose full-stack issues in their cloud applications. It supports both manual and auto instrumentation attach routes. With this public preview we are adding a new auto-instrumentation set of capabilities to .NET apps on Linux App Services, including:

  • Self-contained and framework-dependent deployments
  • Preview of .NET6

You can now onboard newly supported .NET on Linux workloads to Application Insights without having to redeploy and improve the operational quality of your cloud applications and corresponding end user experiences.

Learn more.
